description: A small, fuzzy orange-brown feathered dinosaur with a long tail banded in white and orange leaps from the muddy edge of a dark, misty lake, its claws out and mouth open, with water splashing beneath its feet. A small lizard lies on the driftwood to the right. Behind are dark conifers, ferns and palms under a stormy grey sky. Painterly oil style, edge to edge, no text or border.
